title: Help
intro: How the app works, step by step, and answers to the usual questions. Search, pick a topic, or write to us at the bottom of the page.
heading: How can we help?

steps.title: Start here: the app in four steps
steps.label: Steps

add.title: Add a receipt
how: Tap ＋ in the middle of the bottom bar.
Take a photo, choose photos or a PDF, or forward the e-receipt to your own address.
Wait a few seconds while every line is read.

check.title: Check what was read
how: Look over the lines and their categories.
Anything unsure is marked in yellow — fix it with the pencil.
Tap Save. Nothing is stored before that.

see.title: See where it went
how: Home shows what is left this month — tap the ring to switch views.
Spending shows the categories and each day.
Products shows what each thing costs in each shop.

plan.title: Plan the month
how: Add your salary and rent once in Plan.
Set a goal and let the AI check it.
Plan a holiday with its own budget.

answers.none: Nothing matches “{{query}}”. Write to us below — a person answers.

photo.q: How do I add a receipt?
photo.a: Tap ＋ and take a photo, or choose photos or a PDF. The shop, the date, every line and the total are read; check them and tap Save.

long.q: A long receipt doesn't fit in one photo
long.a: Shoot it in parts that overlap a little, up to 10 photos. A line caught in two photos is counted once.

email.q: How do I forward an e-receipt?
email.a: Settings shows your own forwarding address. Forward the shop's email there from your account's address and the receipt appears a minute later — up to 20 a day.

total.q: The total doesn't match the lines
total.a: Usually a discount was missed: tap “Add the discount” and it is spread over the lines. If a line is missing, open the receipt and fix it. A discount not printed on the receipt at all is added from the receipt too.

manual.a: On the ＋ screen choose “No receipt” and type what, when and how much. It counts like any receipt.

limit.q: How many receipts can I add?
limit.a: Reading a receipt costs a model call, so the free plan reads 10 a month; the count is on the ＋ screen and in Settings. Expenses typed in by hand never count.

foreign.a: It is converted into your account's currency at the rate of its day, and both amounts are kept on the receipt.

where.q: Where do I see what I spent?
where.a: Spending shows the month by category against the one before, a bar for each day and the receipts behind it. Switch to last month, the year or your own dates.

category.q: A line is in the wrong category
category.a: Open the receipt and pick another category for the line. Lines the app was unsure of wait for you on Spending, and a name you correct for a shop is remembered next time.

family.a: In a household, switch Spending from “Mine” to the family: the categories of everyone's shared receipts and a bar a day in a colour per person.

cheaper.q: Where is the same product cheaper?
cheaper.a: Products lists everything you buy however each shop prints it. A product shows its price in each shop, and a mark when another of your shops sold it for less recently.

rename.q: A product has a strange name
rename.a: Tap the pencil beside it and give it your own name. Receipts that print it the old way still land in it.

sets.a: Tick them and open Explore: months, totals and prices side by side. Save them as a set to open again; change a set and save the changes into it.

salary.q: How do I add my salary?
salary.a: Settings › Regular income: the amount and the day it comes. It counts every month by itself; money that came once is added from ＋.

taxes.a: Turn on “I pay my own taxes” in Settings › Money: a rate on each taxed income and a fixed sum a month if you have one. Home then shows what is yours after taxes.

bills.a: Settings › Regular bills: rent, subscriptions, a loan — set once, taken off every month on their day.

balance.q: What is the balance on Home?
balance.a: What is on your accounts now: the amount you entered once, plus income, less purchases and bills since. If it reaches zero, income is probably missing — Home asks.

kinds.a: Save for something, spend less on a category, or a habit such as eating out less. The AI checks the goal against what you actually buy and says whether it is doable.

advice.a: Once there are about 30 days of receipts. Advice names what you actually bought and how much each step would change.

share.a: Create a household in Settings and send the link. Each person keeps their own receipts; Home and Spending can show the family together.

private.a: Mark it private: its money counts in the family's total, but nobody else sees what, where or when.

holiday.q: A holiday with its own budget
holiday.a: Plan › Holidays: dates and a budget. Receipts from those days join it, and you see each day and what is left.

business.a: Turn on business trips in Settings › Work trips. A business trip stays out of your budget and gets a per diem and a settlement for your employer as PDF or CSV.

perdiem.q: How is the per diem counted?
perdiem.a: From the departure and return times you enter, by the official daily rates — today those of Poland, at home and abroad; part days by hours, and meals provided reduce it. More countries will follow.

confirm.q: I didn't get the confirmation email
confirm.a: Look in spam, then press “Send again” on the banner. Until the address is confirmed you can look around but not add receipts.

password.a: On the sign-in screen press “Forgot your password?” and follow the link in the email.

install.q: Can I put it on my phone's home screen?
install.a: Yes: open it in your phone's browser and choose “Add to Home screen”. It then opens like an app.

export.a: Settings › Your data gives one archive with everything you keep here and the photos still kept. Lists on screen can be exported as CSV or JSON.

photos.q: Why did a receipt's photo disappear?
photos.a: Receipt photos are kept 90 days, then deleted; the lines and totals read from them stay.

delete.a: Settings › Your data › Delete account, with your password. Everything goes for good; download your data first if you may need it.

contact.title: Didn't find an answer?
contact.intro: Write to us: the message goes to the people running Budget Agent, and you get a copy.
contact.sent: Thank you — your message is on its way, and a copy is in your inbox.
